reasons.detail: The joint envelope uses frozen training predictors and a serial loaded complete-frame composition; the old trajectory epsilon used the point-model durations.

The old aggregate epsilon covers queues visited by point-duration trajectories. Those complete states are not materialized as a fixed static roster, and changed frame durations change physical-time arrival boundaries.

candidate_evidence_reuse_pre_audit.required_replacement: a separately registered same-envelope static selector screen over an explicit fixed queue roster before any new trajectory

protocol_contract.arrival_model: independent class-wise Poisson arrivals using the existing aligned-frame stream key aligned-frame:{seed}:{coordinate}
protocol_contract.dispatch: global synchronous frames, FIFO within class, arrivals during a frame become eligible only at the next frame boundary

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

protocol_contract.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at 600 seconds and drain the identical finite tape to completion under both policies
protocol_contract.trajectory_support_gate: for each case, the maximum fixed-budget returned gap/L1 over every visited frame and seed is strictly below the same-lane capacity eta

claim_boundary: A one-future-visit 95% joint upper-time audit and conditional local complete-frame capacity calculation based only on the independent joint95-v3 19+1 cohort. It is not time-uniform physical coverage, a trajectory result, or candidate-search closure without separate same-model static support evidence.

score_contract.joint_wave_score: maximum cell_score over exactly nine registered functionals
score_contract.margin: max(0, nineteenth order statistic of 19 joint-wave scores)

decision_rule.CAPACITY_ESTABLISHED_CANDIDATE_PENDING: coverage and every frozen capacity case pass, but comparable candidate-support evidence is unavailable for at least one required case
decision_rule.JOINT95_ALIGNED_CAPACITY_CLOSURE_PASS: coverage, every frozen capacity case, and every required same-model/same-state candidate-support comparison pass
decision_rule.JOINT95_CANDIDATE_SUPPORT_FAIL_STOP: coverage and capacity pass, comparable same-model/same-state epsilon evidence exists, and at least one epsilon is not strictly below eta
decision_rule.JOINT95_HOLDOUT_COVERAGE_FAIL_STOP: the independent wave-33 joint score exceeds the frozen rank-19 margin
decision_rule.JOINT95_NO_POSITIVE_CAPACITY_MARGIN_STOP: coverage passes, but at least one frozen lane/load case has a nonpositive effective capacity slack or a failed structural projection

fixed_capacity_contract.common_capacity_scale_formula: min over R in {8,16} of max s such that s*(R/2)*lambda_point_R2 is in the joint-envelope convex complete-frame service region
fixed_capacity_contract.eta_formula: eta_R(load) = max_{w>=0,sum(w)<=1} min_i [R*sum_a w_a*requirements[a,i]/max(1,tau_upper[a]) - arrival_R(load)[i]] - projection_support_loss_R
fixed_capacity_contract.positive_capacity_gate: every registered R/load structural projection passes and eta_R(load) > 0

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

prohibited: reading v3 visit values or the v3 results directory during registration
using any v1 joint visit, score, margin, release, or results directory
post-result changes to functionals, score, rank, action mapping, lanes, loads, or arrival direction
new trajectory construction or post-result load selection
numeric reuse of epsilon when model or state-population contracts differ
run_preconditions: v3 waves 54..72 each have exactly one dispatcher-valid first-attempt PASS terminal
all nineteen v3 calibration terminals equal the registered predictor anchor
the v3 holdout_release validates and freezes rank 19 (the maximum)
v3 wave 73 has exactly one dispatcher-valid post-release PASS terminal
no v1 or unregistered result artifact is present in the v3 results directory
all frozen source contracts still match this registration

score_and_envelope_contract.complete_frame_offsets: all admitted jobs complete at the action upper duration
score_and_envelope_contract.dedicated_action_upper: its empty drain duration component upper
score_and_envelope_contract.faster_negative_scores: do not enlarge the upper-time margin
score_and_envelope_contract.forbidden_shortcut: do not use predicted_service*(1-margin); reciprocal time scaling is required
score_and_envelope_contract.joint_wave_score: max of the exactly nine registered cell scores
score_and_envelope_contract.loaded_action_upper: loaded target duration component upper + fresh resident empty-p1 drain duration component upper
